study_identification_part.si_4_title: Shared differential factors underlying individual spontaneous neural activity abnormalities in major depressive disorder

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression used to estimate normative ALFF range in HCs.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: for each brain region, a Gaussian process regression was trained to estimate the normative range of ALFF values based on age and sex in HCs.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: ALFF values (mean ALFF per brain region).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: ALFF maps were calculated with the Data Processing Assistant for Resting-State fMRI (DPARSF) protocol (version 5.4) (Chao-Gan & Yu-Feng, 2010). Mean ALFF values were calculated for each brain region defined in the brain connectome atlas (Fan et al., 2016).

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex used as predictors in the normative model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: a Gaussian process regression was trained to estimate the normative range of ALFF values based on age and sex in HCs.
